target: Add per-packet test isolation + per-packet pal/codereview helper so each TP-DMX-ORCH-XXX can advance codereview_status from NOT_RUN to PASS
invariants: Existing bundle-level pytest invocation remains supported
Per-packet test invocation maps each TP to its own targeted test list and verify commands
pal/codereview invocation produces a deterministic record (continuation_id, model, review_type, issues_found)
No proof file is rewritten by this packet; the helper only emits a per-packet codereview snippet that operators paste into the bundle's codereview_status
No new MCP surfaces are exposed

commit.message: feat(orchestrator): per-packet test isolation and codereview helper

pr.title: feat(orchestrator): per-packet test isolation and codereview helper
pr.body: Adds (1) a per-packet test map (config/orchestrator/perpacket_test_map.yaml) so each TP-DMX-ORCH-XXX can be revalidated in isolation, (2) a `dopemux orchestrator perpacket validate <TP>` CLI that runs that packet's targeted pytest + packet/proof validators and emits a JSON summary suitable for pasting into the packet's PROOF.json `validations[]`, and (3) a scripts/orchestrator/perpacket_codereview.py helper that runs pal/codereview against the diff for a given packet's allowlist and emits a codereview_status JSON snippet.

steps.task: Design config/orchestrator/perpacket_test_map.yaml: for each TP-DMX-ORCH-XXX, declare its targeted pytest paths, its packet path, its proof path, and any extra verify commands.
validation: YAML loads cleanly via PyYAML safe_load.
Every TP currently in task-packets/generated/ has an entry.
Missing entries fail loudly with a deterministic error code.

steps.task: Implement src/dopemux/orchestrator/perpacket.py: load the test map, run targeted pytest, packet validate, proof validate, and emit a JSON validations[] suitable for PROOF.json.
validation: Runner returns non-zero on any failure.
JSON output matches the shape used by the existing PROOF.json validations[].

steps.task: Add `dopemux orchestrator perpacket validate TP-DMX-ORCH-XXX --json-output` CLI command.
validation: CLI tests cover present-and-passing, missing-test-map-entry, and pytest-failure paths.
Command does not write to PROOF.json; it only prints the snippet.

steps.task: Implement scripts/orchestrator/perpacket_codereview.py: gather the packet's allowlist, build the relevant diff range, invoke pal/codereview, and emit a JSON codereview_status snippet.
validation: Helper requires pal MCP availability; refuses cleanly if absent.
Output snippet includes result, tool, model, review_type, issues_found, and continuation_id.
Doc explains how to revalidate one TP, how to paste the snippets into PROOF.json, and when each packet can advance from NOT_RUN to PASS.
Doc links to AGENTS.md §9 and the dopetask canonical spec.
Proof status is READY_FOR_REVIEW only after every step's validation array passes.
